ad_library.summary: Ecolt Energy is running 2 live Telugu ads on Meta - both sharing one creative (Library ID 1405421181747986, started 13 October 2026) - selling a 3KW rooftop system at ₹1,90,000 with a ₹33,000 discount plus the ₹78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy, and every click lands in a Facebook lead form. The company has a Hyderabad office in Shaikpet (registered address Narasaraopet, AP) and a polished, calculator-driven website that receives none of the paid traffic.

funnel.meaning: Every click is captured inside Facebook. The polished ecoltenergy.com - savings calculator, project map, WhatsApp chat - is invisible to the buyer the ad just paid for.

findings: 2 live Telugu ads - both sharing one creative (Library ID 1405421181747986, running since 13 October 2026) - and every click lands in a Facebook lead form. ecoltenergy.com receives none of the traffic.
The ad's WhatsApp number (+91 82475 37597) is different from the site's (+91 83411 13782) - two numbers, two funnels, one brand.

The live site's 'Real projects, real power' counters all read 0 - 0 MW capacity installed, 0 projects completed, 0 est. energy generated/yr, 0 CO₂ offset/yr - while the hero banner claims 2,000+ systems installed and 95% average bill reduction.
The site's live weather widget reads 'Right now in Virginia Beach: 16°C, clear skies' - hardcoded to a US city, on a Hyderabad solar company's homepage.

The build is genuinely good (interactive bill-vs-solar comparison, savings calculator, project map across AP & Telangana) - none of it is in the paid path, and there is no pixel or retargeting pool from this spend.
next_steps: Point the ads at an owned page
A landing page on ecoltenergy.com carrying the ad's exact offer - 3KW at ₹1,90,000, ₹33,000 off, subsidy eligibility - so the spend builds one measurable funnel instead of a Facebook form.
Fix the zero counters and the weather widget
0 MW installed and 0 projects next to a '2,000+ systems' claim, plus a Virginia Beach widget, are the first things a paid visitor checks.
The ad says +91 82475 37597, the site says +91 83411 13782. One number, everywhere, so the paid click and the site agree.
Two ads on one creative with no pixel means no audience to bring back and no way to see who dropped off after the click.

controls.name: Meta Pixel installed
controls.evidence: Landing page was not source-checked for this report; needs a page-source pull or account access.

controls.name: UTM parameters on ad destinations
controls.evidence: Live ads click to a Facebook lead form (fb.me) - traffic never reaches a page you own, so no URL can carry UTMs and click data stays inside Meta.

controls.name: Domain verification
controls.evidence: Business Manager domain verification cannot be observed from public ad data; needs account access.

controls.name: Creative format diversity
controls.evidence: Ad-card formats were not captured for these ads.

controls.name: Creative concept coverage
controls.evidence: 3 distinct offer angles in live copy: government subsidy, subsidy amount, discount offer.

controls.name: Social proof utilization
controls.evidence: No social proof (customer counts, reviews, testimonials) in the live ad copy.

controls.name: Video aspect ratios
controls.evidence: Creative files cannot be downloaded from the Ad Library; needs account access or the raw creatives.

controls.name: UGC / social-native content
controls.evidence: Content style cannot be verified from ad cards alone.

controls.name: CTR benchmark
controls.evidence: No spend or impression data is public for this advertiser; the catalog forbids benchmark guessing.

controls.name: Creative freshness
controls.evidence: Live creatives include recent launches (newest started Oct 13, 2026) - the account is not running one stale ad forever.

controls.name: Campaign fragmentation
controls.evidence: A single live ad - no internal comparison, no safety net if it fatigues.

controls.name: Campaign objective alignment
controls.evidence: Ad CTA and destination agree on one job: Facebook lead form only.

controls.name: Creative fatigue detection
controls.evidence: Frequency and performance decay need account metrics.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
